verdict.rationale: Wave documents simple built-in automations: scheduled overdue reminders, recurring invoices with an automatic/manual billing switch, and auto-categorized bank transactions. So asking whether those automations can be versioned, reviewed and rolled back is a fair question for this product. The evidence shows no version history, change review, or rollback for any automation; the automatic/manual billing toggle is an adjacent control, not versioning or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
